reading.title: NASA’s Webb Shows How Supernova Dust Chronicles Star Evolution
reading.summary: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has painted a vibrant tapestry of the legendary supernova remnant Cassiopeia A (Cas A). Remnants like these are the clouds of gas and dust that remain following the explosion of a massive star and will eventually seed a new generation of stars and planets. news.title: Burnham says it would be ‘unthinkable’ for the UK to rejoin the EU without a referendum – as it happened
news.summary: The prime minister’s remarks were the clearest commitment yet to not joining the EU without another vote In her speech, Louise Haigh announced that Juergen Maier, chair of Great British Energy, has been appointed as the government’s northern economy and reindustrialisation commissioner. She said: Giving business the confidence to invest here, and create good jobs in our industrial heartlands. Creating good quality jobs in all parts of the country. The role of the private sector is essential to fulfilling that. That is why I am delighted to announce today a new northern economy and reindustrialisation commissioner. With an impeccable industrial career we can learn much from, welcome, Juergen Maier. Continue reading...
